reality.label: THE CURRENT REALITY
reality.quote: They're not missing donors. They're missing a system.
reality.body: Families spend hours on phone calls, WhatsApp groups, and hospital queues — hoping someone will show up. It's not a donor shortage. It's a coordination crisis.

mission.label: OUR MISSION
mission.quote: Every Thalassemia patient deserves a donor who keeps coming back.
mission.para1: Thalassemia Major is not a one-time crisis. It is a lifelong condition where a child's survival depends entirely on access to compatible blood, on schedule, every 2–5 weeks. Forever.
mission.para2: Blood Warriors Foundation has spent years building a donor community and Blood Bridge network across India. But the matching is manual. The engagement fades. The coordination is fragile.
mission.para3: Raksha AI was built to be the infrastructure Blood Warriors never had — an intelligent, adaptive, multilingual platform that matches donors to patients.

metric.label: The North Star Metric
metric.heading: Compressing the Critical Hour
metric.subheading: When hemoglobin crashes, every second counts. Here is how Raksha AI replaces chaotic human logistics with automated precision.
metric.whatsappDesc: Anxious families broadcast requests to spammy groups hoping for replies.
metric.callingDesc: Dialing outdated contacts, experiencing dropouts, and facing mismatch risks.
metric.delayDesc: Manual confirmation, check-in delays, and coordination gaps at the bedside.
metric.aiMatchDesc: Instant screening based on ABO/Rh history, location, and alloimmunization risk.
metric.outreachDesc: Smart agents trigger multi-channel alerts (WhatsApp/SMS), securing immediate confirmations.
metric.deliveryDesc: Donor routes are tracked in real-time, and hospital check-in is pre-authorized.
metric.statement: Raksha AI reduces average donor-to-bedside time from 4.2 hours to under 45 minutes at scale.
metric.footerText: Ensuring a predictable supply cycle for all registered Thalassemia warriors.

engine.label: The Raksha AI Engine
engine.headline: Smarter matching. Proactive scheduling. Zero guesswork.
engine.feature1Desc: Antigen-aware matching with alloimmunization risk prediction. Thalassemia patients develop antibodies against repeated donors; our model predicts and avoids high-risk pairings.
engine.feature2Desc: Machine learning models analyze hemoglobin trends, transfusion history, and individual patient patterns to predict the optimal next transfusion date — before it becomes urgent.
engine.feature3Desc: Our models analyze each donor's personal dropout signals (response delay, declining frequency) and proactively trigger re-engagement alerts before they ghost, not after.
engine.feature4Desc: When a patient needs blood, Raksha AI automatically contacts eligible donors via SMS and WhatsApp in their preferred language. No more manual phone trees.
engine.feature5Desc: When an outreach batch has <30% response rate, the system auto-tags those donors as low-availability and deprioritises them. SageMaker retrains the ranking model weekly.
engine.feature6Desc: Amazon Bedrock stores conversation context across sessions so a patient's caregiver doesn't have to re-explain the patient's history every call—persistent memory over repeated interactions.
